milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the agent must navigate near the potted pink tulip at spawn-relative (3, 1, -2) on the east wall and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. This rule type is preferred for find tasks as it models 'player can see the target' without requiring them to stand on top of it. The 5-block max_distance is appropriate for the 7x7 room interior, and 60° facing tolerance ensures intentional visual engagement rather than accidental proximity.
